name: NemoNoise Commercial Readiness
description: Upgrade NemoNoise from prototype to polished, distributable macOS voice dictation app. Focus: ASR quality, minimalist UX, engineering rigor, and release infrastructure.

userStories.title: Add isStreaming property to ASRService protocol
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to distinguish streaming vs batch engines so the UI can show real-time text or waveform accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `var isStreaming: Bool { get }` to ASRService protocol with default extension returning true
SherpaASREngine (SenseVoice) returns isStreaming=false
ParaformerStreamingEngine returns isStreaming=true
AppleSpeechASREngine returns isStreaming=true
All existing conforming types compile without changes beyond the new property
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Overlay waveform-only mode for non-streaming engines
userStories.description: As a user, when using a batch ASR engine, I should see only a volume waveform during recording, with text appearing once after recording ends.
acceptanceCriteria: Overlay reads engine's isStreaming property to decide display mode
When isStreaming=false: overlay shows only LiveWaveformView animation, hides transcript area during recording
When isStreaming=true: overlay shows streaming text as before
On recording end with batch engine: waveform replaced by final transcription text in one shot
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Engine auto-fallback on crash or failure
userStories.description: As a user, if my chosen ASR engine fails during recording, the app should silently fall back to Apple Speech and notify me.
acceptanceCriteria: SpeechOrchestrator catches errors from active ASR engine during recording
On engine error: auto-switches to AppleSpeechASREngine as fallback
Shows a non-intrusive toast: 'switched to local engine'
Logs the fallback event with original engine name and error details
Recording continues without interruption after fallback
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Structured logging with session ID correlation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need structured logs with session IDs so I can debug per-recording-session issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Each recording session generates a unique UUID session ID
All log calls during a session include the session ID in the log message
Log levels follow the spec: Error/Warn/Info/Debug with defined categories
Audio capture logs: device change, sample rate, buffer size, start/stop
ASR engine logs: init duration, recognition duration, result length, error codes
Text injection logs: injection method (AX/clipboard), duration
CocoaLumberjack config: 5MB max file size, 7 day retention, auto-rotate
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: First-launch onboarding flow
userStories.description: As a new user, I want a quick 3-step onboarding so I can start using the app immediately.
acceptanceCriteria: On first launch, show a 3-step onboarding: Step 1: request microphone permission
Step 2: select engine (default Paraformer, with Apple Speech as option)
Step 3: show hotkey (Right Cmd or Option) and explain push-to-talk
Each step has Next/Skip button, final step has 'Get Started' button
Onboarding completes: save flag to UserDefaults so it never shows again
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Simplify overlay: auto-fade and toast for failures
userStories.description: As a user, I want the overlay to auto-fade after text injection and show a subtle notification if injection fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove manual close button from overlay
After successful text injection: overlay auto-fades out over 2 seconds
On injection failure: text copies to clipboard, show toast 'copied to clipboard' for 3 seconds, then fade
No big 'Copy to Clipboard' button, just the toast notification
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Simplify settings to 2 tabs
userStories.description: As a user, I want minimal settings — just engine choice and hotkey — so the app feels simple.
acceptanceCriteria: Settings window has exactly 2 tabs: Engine and Shortcuts
Engine tab: engine picker (local Paraformer default / Apple Speech), model download/delete section
Shortcuts tab: hotkey selector, accessibility permission prompt
Remove: General tab, Language selection, Recording mode toggle, Emotion tag toggle
All removed preferences default to sensible values (auto-detect language, push-to-talk mode, no emotion UI)
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Add test target with key path coverage
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated tests for critical paths to ship with confidence.
acceptanceCriteria: New test target NemoNoiseTests added to Xcode project
ASRService mock test: verify protocol conformance and isStreaming property
SpeechOrchestrator test: verify engine selection and fallback logic
AudioCapture lifecycle test: start/stop/re-entry handling
TextInjector test: AX injection path and clipboard fallback
ModelManager test: download state machine transitions
All tests pass via xcodebuild test

userStories.title: Integrate Sentry crash reporting
userStories.description: As a developer, I need crash reports from users to fix issues I can't reproduce locally.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Sentry Swift SDK dependency (SPM)
Initialize Sentry in NemoNoiseApp with DSN from config
Capture crashes and non-fatal errors (engine init failure, audio session exceptions)
Add opt-out toggle in settings (off by default for privacy)
Respect opt-out: skip Sentry init when disabled
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: Integrate Sparkle 2 for auto-updates
userStories.description: As a user, I want the app to update automatically so I always have the latest version.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Sparkle 2 framework via SPM or XCFramework
Configure SUFeedURL to point at GitHub Releases appcast
Add 'Check for Updates' menu item in app menu
Sparkle respects user's automatic update preferences
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: CloudASREngine with Alibaba Cloud Paraformer API
userStories.description: As a user who provides an API key, I can use cloud-based Paraformer for higher accuracy transcription.
acceptanceCriteria: New CloudASREngine conforms to ASRService protocol with isStreaming=true
Sends audio chunks to Alibaba Cloud Paraformer REST API
API Key stored in and retrieved from macOS Keychain
API Key input field in Engine tab of settings
When API Key is set: cloud engine appears as option in engine picker
When API Key is empty: cloud engine not shown
Handles API errors: timeout → fallback to local engine with toast, auth failure → prompt re-enter key
Logs: request latency, HTTP status, token count, retry count
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: One-click log export with sanitization
userStories.description: As a user reporting a bug, I can export recent logs with one click, with PII removed.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'Export Logs' button in settings or debug menu
Clicking it saves last 7 days of logs to a file on Desktop
Sanitize exported logs: remove target app names, file paths containing usernames
Show confirmation with file path after export
xcodebuild build succeeds

userStories.title: GitHub Actions CI for auto-build
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CI to verify every PR builds successfully before merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Create .github/workflows/ci.yml
Trigger on push to main/develop and on pull requests
Job: checkout, install Xcode, xcodebuild build for macOS
Job: xcodebuild test for NemoNoiseTests target
Build fails on compilation errors or test failures
Status badge in README

userStories.title: dmg packaging and GitHub Releases v1.0
userStories.description: As a user, I can download a dmg from GitHub Releases and drag the app to Applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a build script that produces a signed .dmg
dmg contains NemoNoise.app and Applications symlink
App icon set (placeholder if no professional icon yet)
README with: features list, screenshot, install instructions, supported OS version
GitHub Release created as v1.0 with dmg artifact and release notes
Sparkle appcast.xml generated alongside the release
